sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Twenty-five selected parameters include the new persistent site fraction along with water binding, liquid relaxation, retention and liquid mobility. Permeability, pore radius, condensation factor, evaporation A/E and staged atmosphere remain fixed; liquid latent contrast and transition width are also not sampled. Added sampled dimension changes other draws, so cross-ensemble differences cannot be assigned to site evolution alone. Eight paired samples do not establish all-parameter or permeability/atmosphere-range robustness, measured site survival or qualified-process optimization.
